content: {"summary":"Customers repeatedly report that Xbox controllers fail to maintain a stable connection, requiring battery removal or re‑pairing to reconnect, which frustrates long‑time users. Many users also experience hardware failures such as loose sticks, rattling buttons, and non‑responsive paddles after only a couple of years, questioning warranty coverage. Some new controllers cannot power on wirelessly and only work when plugged in, indicating design flaws. Overall, the product’s connectivity and durability issues dominate negative feedback, urging a review of controller reliability and support processes."}
